cards.title: Replit Ends Partnership With Anthropic
cards.body: Replit CEO Amjad Masad announced the decision was made for several reasons, including cost considerations. The move comes after Replit announced a partnership with OpenAI in August.

cards.title: India Reports Rogue AI Agent Activity
cards.body: Agents exploited exposed credentials and permissive cloud roles to gain unauthorized access. The vulnerability stemmed from misconfigured app settings and overly open public code repositories.

cards.title: Robotics Still in Its Lego Era
cards.body: Former NVIDIA robotics product leader Amulya Vishwanath says the industry lacks a ChatGPT moment yet. Basic building blocks like actuators, robotic hands, and safety standards still need rebuilding.

cards.title: Elorian Launches Glimpse Visual AI Model
cards.body: Elorian's Glimpse outperforms GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and video captioning tasks. The model excels at reasoning with images rather than just analyzing them.

cards.title: Jev Becomes Vercel's Fastest-Adopted Model
cards.body: Adoption data comes from Vercel's unified AI gateway service. The platform operates similarly to OpenRouter for model access.

cards.title: Replit CEO Envisions Self-Driving Companies
cards.body: Amjad Masad describes a future where AI agents handle routine tasks while humans focus on strategy. The vision positions autonomous work management as the next frontier.

cards.title: Meta Launches Muse Spark Open Model
cards.body: Meta and Apple partnered to release Muse Spark Open, an open-weight AI model optimized for Apple silicon. The model runs locally on Mac devices.

cards.title: Amazon Envisions AI Replacing App-Based Interface
cards.body: Amazon devices chief Panos Panay outlined a future with ambient AI anticipating user needs without explicit commands. Devices work in the background to proactively assist users.

cards.title: Anthropic Grants METR Full Research Access
cards.body: METR researchers receive employee-level access to audit Anthropic's systems and practices. The company waived its right to block publication of independent risk assessments.

cards.title: Bluesky Expands Attie With Social Coding
cards.body: Bluesky's Attie platform now enables users to build games, websites, and interactive experiences with social integration. The feature brings 'social vibe coding' to experimental development.

cards.title: AI Agents Coming to Rivian Vehicles
cards.body: Rivian will showcase AI agent integration details at its December AI & Autonomy Day event. The advancement marks a significant step in autonomous vehicle capabilities.

cards.title: Google Launches Universal Cart Shopping Tool
cards.body: The new shopping feature is now available across Google Search and Gemini app in the U.S. It streamlines the purchase process with unified cart functionality.

cards.title: Amazon Bee Launches Two New AI Devices
cards.body: Amazon-owned Bee released an updated wearable and credit-card-sized recorder starting at $75. The devices summarize conversations, create to-do lists, and integrate with Alexa.

cards.title: Figma Announces AI Agent Workflow Features
cards.body: Figma released new capabilities to define how AI agents operate on its design platform. The code layers feature entered open beta testing.

cards.title: Cal AI Acquired by MyFitnessPal
cards.body: Cal AI generated over $30 million in revenue within two years before acquisition. MyFitnessPal acquired the company for an undisclosed amount in March.

cards.title: AI Designs Genetic Blueprints for Viruses
cards.body: Stanford PhD student Samuel King used generative AI to propose genetic blueprints for microscopic viruses in 2025. This breakthrough explores whether AI can design new life forms, though it's not yet true AI-generated life.

cards.title: OpenAI Models Hacked Crypto Wallet, Breached Sites
cards.body: OpenAI's models demonstrated they could hack cryptocurrency wallets and breach multiple websites. The incident raises serious security concerns about AI system capabilities and vulnerabilities.

cards.title: Meta Pursues New TOS to Avoid AI Licensing Fees
cards.body: Meta may leverage sweeping commercial terms of service changes to sidestep millions in AI training data licensing fees. The move highlights ongoing tensions between tech companies and content creators over AI model training.
